title: My tasks
description: What is asked of you, what you asked of others, and what you follow.
searchPlaceholder: Search by title or task number
noMatches: No tasks match your search or filters.

empty.created: You have not asked anyone for anything
empty.following: You are not following any task

emptyHint.assigned: Open tasks given to you, or created by you for yourself, appear here, ordered by due date.
emptyHint.created: Tasks you give to other people appear here so you can follow their progress.
emptyHint.following: Open a task and choose Follow to see it here.
emptyHint.team: Tasks of your direct reports, or of everyone below you, appear here.

board.label: Task board
board.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} tasks. Narrow the list with the search or the filters.

moveReason.NO_CHANGE: The task is already in this status.
moveReason.AWAITING_APPROVAL: A task waiting for approval moves only when the approver approves or rejects it.
moveReason.REJECTED_TASK: A rejected task is sent again for approval by its owner; it is not moved.
moveReason.NOT_ALLOWED_PATH: A task cannot move between these two statuses.
moveReason.NOT_ASSIGNEE: Only the assignee, or a manager of the team, can do this move.
moveReason.NOT_REVIEWER: Only the reviewer can accept the work or send it back.
moveReason.NOT_CREATOR_OR_MANAGER: Only whoever gave the task, or a manager, can reopen it.
moveReason.REVIEW_NOT_REQUIRED: This task does not need a review.

transition.noteDescription: The task goes back to the assignee. Write what is missing.
transition.dateDescription: The task is later than the allowed time. State the real day it was finished.
transition.completedOnHint: It can go back only as far as the policy allows.

matrix.title: Task matrix
matrix.description: Your open tasks in four squares: important or not, urgent or not. A task is important when its priority is high; it is urgent when it is due soon, overdue or marked urgent.

important_not_urgent.title: Important, not urgent
important_not_urgent.hint: Plan them before they become urgent.

normal_urgent.title: Urgent, not important
normal_urgent.hint: Finish them quickly or hand them over.

normal_not_urgent.title: Neither
normal_not_urgent.hint: Do them when there is time.

form.newDescription: Give a task to yourself or to someone you may.
form.title: Title
form.noTags: Your department has not created any tags yet.
form.dueInPast: The due date cannot be in the past.
form.recurrenceEndHint: Leave empty to repeat without an end.
form.approvedBy: This task is for yourself, so it will be approved by {{name}}.
form.noApproval: This task is for yourself and nobody has to approve it.

details.pageHint: Everything about this task: who, when, and what happened.
details.creator: Given by
details.archivedNote: This task was archived on {{date}}. It can be restored.
details.objectionNote: {{name}} objected ({{reason}}). The objection lapses on {{date}} if nobody answers.
details.pendingNote: This task waits for the approval of {{name}}.

actions.unfollowed: You no longer follow this task.

approve.title: Approve the task
approve.description: The task moves to To do for its owner.

reject.title: Reject the task
reject.description: The task is refused. Its owner may edit it and send it again.

resubmit.title: Send the task again
resubmit.description: The task goes back to your manager for approval.

objection.title: Object to the task
objection.description: Choose why. Unanswered, the objection lapses after a few working days and the task stays with you.
objection.answerDescription: Rejecting keeps the task with its assignee. Accepting gives it to somebody else, who is told.
objection.accept: I accept the objection and give the task to someone else
objection.reject: I keep the task with its assignee
objection.newAssigneeHint: Only people you may give a task to are offered.

time.title: Log time
time.description: Record the time you worked on this task.

tags.title: Task tags
tags.description: Each department keeps its own tags for its tasks, such as reports or meetings.
tags.name: Tag
tags.dialogDescription: A tag belongs to one department.
tags.deleteBody: The tag {{name}} will be deleted. If tasks use it, turn it off instead.
tags.emptyHint: No department has created tags. Add the first one.

policies.title: Task policies
policies.description: Every number of the task rules for a company. Each has limits so no value can switch tasks off.
policies.outOfRange: Use a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

sections.timeHint: When a task counts as urgent, when its owner is reminded, and how far back a date may be recorded.
sections.followHint: When a task counts as stale and how long an objection waits.
sections.reportsHint: The day of the managers' summary and how long closed standalone tasks stay before they are archived.

fields.digestWeekday: Day of the managers' summary (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday)
